question.html:
A particle moves along a horizontal straight line. At a particular instant, the particle has a negative velocity and a positive acceleration. Which of the following correctly describes the motion of the particle at this instant?

  1. It is moving in the positive direction and its speed is increasing.
  2. It is moving in the negative direction and its speed is decreasing.
  3. It is moving in the negative direction and its speed is increasing.
  4. It is moving in the positive direction and its speed is decreasing.
